linux_kernel_abi_runtime_proof: PENDING: fake Linux binding layout and operations model the reference contract; no native kernel compilation or live Linux MM teardown was executed. mm_count ownership confers neither mapping access nor guest-root ownership.
extraction: The exact complete ForkChildOwner struct, unsafe Send/Sync implementations, current acquisition and Drop implementation are extracted between the Structural MM comment and FORK BACKEND RESERVATION marker in smp_application.rs. They execute unchanged in the harness, not a rewritten ownership model.
profile: Dispatcher-approved CPU6, one job,2GiB AS,120s overall/60s compiler,nofile256,core0,pinned host Rust1.92,serial tests; no root/Docker/network/guest/child agent/Git.
observations: Missing PID returns ESRCH without MM acquisition. Missing MM releases the acquired PID exactly once.
PID numbers0/-1 return ESRCH after transient mmput and put_pid once, without structural increment.
mm_count i32::MAX/0/-1 return overflow/error without changing the structural count; transient MM/PID references are released once.
Success holds one PID and one structural mm_count reference while returning the transient mm_users reference immediately. Ordinary owner Drop restores the original count without __mmdrop.

Simulated Linux last-user teardown drops the original structural reference while the exact production owner retains count1. Final owner Drop decrements to0, invokes __mmdrop exactly once and put_pid exactly once.
Executable mutants remove the missing-MM put_pid or change the Drop decrement to increment. The same balance oracles reject both; the mutated PID ref leaks1 and corrupted structural count becomes3.

failure_family.original: First harness compile failed because fake unit struct pid conflicted with adapter parameter pattern pid, producing E0308/E0369/E0277. This is a fixture adapter naming error, not production ownership failure.
failure_family.correction: Single bounded correction renames only those two adapter parameters and uses to selected_pid. No oracle or production body changed.
